changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_trial ( user_id, initiation_date, initiated_by, activation_date, activation_key, license_agreement_name, license_agreement_version, license_agreement_acceptance_date ) SELECT ud.user_id, CASE JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.activation.initiationDate')) WHEN 'STRING' THEN STR_TO_DATE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.activation.initiationDate')), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') WHEN 'OBJECT' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME( CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.activation.initiationDate.seconds')) AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) + COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.activation.initiationDate.nanos')) AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) / 1000000000, 0) ) WHEN 'INTEGER' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.activation.initiationDate')) AS DECIMAL(20, 6))) ELSE NULL END, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.activation.initiatedBy')), CASE JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.activation.activationDate')) WHEN 'STRING' THEN STR_TO_DATE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.activation.activationDate')), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') WHEN 'OBJECT' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME( CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.activation.activationDate.seconds')) AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) + COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.activation.activationDate.nanos')) AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) / 1000000000, 0) ) WHEN 'INTEGER' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.activation.activationDate')) AS DECIMAL(20, 6))) ELSE NULL END, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.activation.key')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.licenseAgreement.name')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.licenseAgreement.version')), CASE JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.licenseAgreement.acceptanceDate')) WHEN 'STRING' THEN STR_TO_DATE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.licenseAgreement.acceptanceDate')), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') WHEN 'OBJECT' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME( CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.licenseAgreement.acceptanceDate.seconds')) AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) + COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.licenseAgreement.acceptanceDate.nanos')) AS DECIMAL(20, 6)) / 1000000000, 0) ) WHEN 'INTEGER' THEN FROM_UNIXTIME(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount.licenseAgreement.acceptanceDate')) AS DECIMAL(20, 6))) ELSE NULL END FROM user_details ud WHERE JSON_EXTRACT(ud.additional_info, '$.trialAccount') IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: oncokb
changeSet.sql: UPDATE user_details ud LEFT JOIN user_trial ut ON ut.user_id = ud.user_id SET ud.trial_status = CASE WHEN ut.activation_key IS NOT NULL AND ut.license_agreement_acceptance_date IS NULL THEN 'TRIAL_PENDING_TERMS_ACCEPTANCE' WHEN ut.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'TRIAL' ELSE 'REGULAR' END WHERE ud.trial_status IS NULL;

changeSet.author: oncokb
changeSet.sql: UPDATE user_details ud SET trial_status = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_trial ut WHERE ut.user_id = ud.user_id AND ut.activation_key IS NOT NULL AND ut.license_agreement_acceptance_date IS NULL ) THEN 'TRIAL_PENDING_TERMS_ACCEPTANCE' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_trial ut WHERE ut.user_id = ud.user_id ) THEN 'TRIAL' ELSE 'REGULAR' END WHERE ud.trial_status IS NULL;

changeSet.author: oncokb
changeSet.sql: UPDATE user_details SET additional_info = CASE WHEN additional_info IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE JSON_REMOVE(additional_info, '$.trialAccount') END;
